html:
The Shawnee are an Algonquian-speaking people of the Ohio Valley, among the most widely travelled Native nations of eastern North America. Their name means "southerners". In the late 1600s, under pressure from the Haudenosaunee in the Beaver Wars, their bands scattered as far as South Carolina, Alabama, Illinois and Pennsylvania; one group helped destroy the Westo. In the 1700s they drew back to the Ohio country.

There they fought the advance of British and American settlers for half a century. The brothers Tecumseh and Tenskwatawa, the Prophet, built a wide Native alliance, which was broken at the Battle of Tippecanoe in 1811 and by Tecumseh's death in the War of 1812. The Shawnee were removed west in the 1830s, and three Shawnee tribes now live in Oklahoma, among them the Absentee Shawnee. Earlier maps show them as Shawnee.
